module: Node "File Exists" (category once_p_duration). Checks that a file exists. Inputs: file (path or name), extension (hidden, appended to the name). Outputs: exists and missing (flow), existsBool (bool), path (absolute path). Uses mgr:getRelativeAbsolutePath, which resolves the path relative to the project.
notes: The description of the missing pin says "If the file exists" (copy-paste) while it signals that the file is absent.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

workOnce.desc: Builds the name, resolves the absolute path via mgr:getRelativeAbsolutePath and writes exists, missing, existsBool and path.
